message: Executor-instruction delivery findings for the docs workstream: browser-scripts/chatgpt/launchAgent.js receives only the rendered project launch-template prompt. agent_inbox separately returns the current role attachment layers and nonempty per-agent override alongside the focused assignment. get_agent_instructions is an explicit read: its first page returns workspace/project/directory AGENTS.md plus the same role/agent layers; ordinary source operations do not auto-inject AGENTS.md. Resolver precedence is global, workspace, project/directory, role attachment order, agent, assignment. Worker 2 (Worker v7) and Reviewer 1 (Reviewer v5) both have empty agent-specific overrides; Reviewer role currently does not ask for AGENTS.md, unlike Worker. I am consolidating role/launch content and adding tests; please align docs with this actual delivery path. The parent workspace AGENTS.md is outside the project worktree and cannot be edited through project source tools.
